title: Your Agentic LLMs Secretly Encode Indirect Prompt-Injection Exposure in Hidden States
abstract: arXiv:2608.02657v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Agentic LLMs are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks, e.g., malicious side-tasks hidden in external tool results. While many efforts have sought to address this threat, little is known about the internals of agentic LLMs when they are exposed to IPI attacks. For simplicity, we refer to this condition as IPI exposure. In this paper, we study IPI exposure from three perspectives. (1) Probing: Across eight models, including the 753B-parameter GLM-5.2 and the 2.8T-parameter Kimi-K3, simple linear probes trained on pre-generation hidden states can predict LLMs' IPI exposure. These probes achieve 0.90+ AUROC on unseen attacks, agent instructions, and task suites; they remain robustly predictive under adaptive attacks and in cross-lingual settings. (2) Defense: We reveal and diagnose a knowledge-action gap: post-trained LLMs encode signals predictive of IPI exposure, yet do not reliably bind these signals to safe age

translated_title: 你的智能体大语言模型在隐藏状态中秘密编码间接提示注入暴露
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.02657v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：智能体大语言模型（Agentic LLMs）容易受到间接提示注入（IPI）攻击，例如隐藏在外部工具结果中的恶意副作用任务。尽管许多努力旨在应对这一威胁，但关于智能体大语言模型在暴露于IPI攻击时的内部机制知之甚少。为简化起见，我们将这种状况称为IPI暴露。在本文中，我们从三个角度研究IPI暴露。（1）探测：在包括753B参数的GLM-5.2和2.8T参数的Kimi-K3在内的八个模型中，基于生成前隐藏状态训练的简单线性探针可以预测LLM的IPI暴露。这些探针在未见攻击、智能体指令和任务套件上实现了0.90以上的AUROC；它们在自适应攻击和跨语言设置下仍保持稳健的预测能力。（2）防御：我们揭示并诊断了一种知识-行动差距：经过后训练的LLM编码了可预测IPI暴露的信号，但并未可靠地将这些信号绑定到安全行为上。
tldr: 本文发现智能体大语言模型的隐藏状态中编码了可预测间接提示注入暴露的信号，并揭示了模型在知识-行动上的关键差距。
en_tdlr: This paper discovers that agentic LLMs encode predictable signals of indirect prompt-injection exposure in hidden states, revealing a critical knowledge-action gap in their defenses.
